subject: MAP kickoff: draft + timeline options
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Allison Chen <allison.chen@vireohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: draft + timeline options

Hi Allison — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for taking the time to walk through Vireo's ingestion patterns and the primary use cases (patient triage summaries + anonymized research embeddings). Per our agreement on the call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that frames milestones, owners, and two timeline options so we can pick the cadence that fits your procurement/technical windows.

High-level recap from discovery:
- Primary pilot: anonymized embeddings for retrospective research (Q3 pilot)
- Success criteria: 1) embeddings parity vs baseline, 2) average inference latency < 200ms P95, 3) cost target below $0.12 per 1k tokens
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence requested, on-prem deployment optional for PHI 

Quick asks / next steps (please confirm by EOD Monday):
1) Confirm stakeholder roster (technical, procurement, security) — I noted the names below; add/delete as needed.
2) Pick a timeline option (A = fast/parallel, target close 2025-08-29; B = staged, target close 2025-09-30).
3) Confirm who will own each milestone in the MAP (we've suggested owners in column C of the attachment).
4) Any blocking dependencies we should capture now (e.g., procurement window, legal redlines, on-prem approvals).

Attachments included:
- MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, risk register)
- discovery-notes-20250718.pdf (call notes, open questions)

Timeline option summary (in the attachment as well):
- Option A (Accelerated):
  - Week 1: MAP sign + PO commitment
  - Weeks 2–3: Technical onboarding (data ingestion + test dataset)
  - Weeks 4–6: Pilot execution and validation
  - Week 7: Results review + scale decision
  - Target close: 2025-08-29
- Option B (Staged):
  - Weeks 1–2: MAP sign + procurement prep
  - Weeks 3–6: Technical onboarding (longer validation, security review)
  - Weeks 7–10: Extended pilot + integration work
  - Target close: 2025-09-30

Marissa/Monica — tagging you to own the technical checklist and the SOC2 evidence pull respectively. I'll coordinate the procurement cadence with Allison and David.

Appreciate quick confirmation on stakeholders and preferred timeline so we can lock the MAP and circulate to legal/procurement.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

---
From: Allison Chen <allison.chen@vireohealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@vireohealth-proc.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: draft + timeline options

Sean — thanks for the note and the clear recap. On the roster: please add David Kim (procurement) to the MAP as procurement owner; I'm the program sponsor. Also adding our security lead (external): Sarah Liu (sarah.liu@vireohealth-security.com) — she will need the SOC2 + architecture diagram.

Quick answers:
- Preferred timeline: Option A looks good but procurement asks for an internal approval window. If PO is required, our realistic close may be 2025-09-02. Can you accommodate a target close of 2025-09-02 instead of 08-29?
- Dependencies: legal will need a marked redline; our standard SLA edits often take ~10 business days. Also confirm if the pilot needs to run on our VPC (we flagged on-prem as optional).

I've looped David on this thread so he sees the MAP and the timeline ask. David — can you confirm procurement timeline and whether a PO is required for moving to Option A?

Thanks — Allison
Director, Data & Research | Vireo Health Systems
allison.chen@vireohealth.com | (617) 555-0136

Allison / David / Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for adding procurement/security. Per Allison's note, we've updated the MAP to reflect the procurement window and added a third timeline variant (Option A-1) that keeps the accelerated path but moves target close to 2025-09-02 and adds a 2-week legal buffer for redlines.

Key updates in MAP_revision_v2.xlsx (attached):
- New Option A-1: accelerated + 2-week legal buffer (target close 2025-09-02)
- Milestone owners: Procurement = David Kim; Security evidence = Sarah Liu (Vireo) + Monica (Redwood) for evidence upload; Technical onboarding = Marissa Cole
- Risk register: flagged SLA redline and on-prem approval as primary dependencies

Marissa — can you confirm you can run the onboarding checklist in a parallel cadence (we'll provide a short-run test dataset and onboarding scripts)?
Monica — can you prepare the SOC2 artifact bundle and a brief architecture diagram (mockup) for Sarah?

Attachments included: MAP_revision_v2.xlsx (milestones + A-1 option), discovery-notes-20250718.pdf

I'll schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff next Tuesday to align stakeholders if that works for everyone; propose 10am PT. If we get confirmations this morning we'll lock calendar and send invites.

Best,
Sean
